assumptions: No combat upgrades or building buffs unless explicitly listed; no towers or reinforcements.
90-second limit, 20 simulation steps/second; mirrored deployment and side order.
Cost budget sums wood/stone/food equally; this is not a real economic model.
Time samples use 60 seconds of one L1 or L3 producer. Area-time-L3 uses 9 military cells, unique-building limits and a 48-slot cap, without construction/economy costs.
Pure support duels are included for completeness, not a rating of their utility.
